title: InstanceCode
description: This schema defines the InstanceCode entity. An `InstanceCode` is a single code value belonging to a named code group (e.g. group `PAYMENT_METHOD`, value `01` = 'Credit Card').

id.description: Unique identifier of this InstanceCode instance.

name.description: A unique name that identifies this InstanceCode. Example: 'PAYMENT_METHOD_01'.

codeGroup.description: Code group identifier this code belongs to. Example: 'PAYMENT_METHOD'.

codeGroupName.description: Display name of the code group. Example: '결제수단코드'.

codeValue.description: The code value within the group. Example: '01'.

codeName.description: Display name for the code value. Example: '결제수단코드 1'.

sortOrder.description: Sort order of this code within its group.

registeredDate.description: Date this code was registered, in 'yyyyMMdd' format.

active.description: Whether this code is currently active.

updatedAt.description: Last update time corresponding to the new version of the entity in Unix epoch time milliseconds.

href.description: Link to the resource corresponding to this entity.

changeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

incrementalChangeDescription.description: Change that lead to this version of the entity.

deleted.description: When `true` indicates the entity has been soft deleted.
